description: The same question on the `us` pack, with the opposite answer — and the point is that it IS an answer. No US form in the pack owes a statutory resolution on the result: the year closes into retained earnings, which is also why `us-appropriation` offers `carryForward` and nothing else. The pack ships the catalogue anyway rather than leaving it out, because the two silences read differently: without the module `resolutionRequired` would be `null` (nobody has said what this company is) and with it `false` (this form resolves nothing). That distinction is what an application needs in order to decide between showing a deadline, showing nothing, and asking the user a question. `sizeClasses` is empty for the same reason — this jurisdiction grades no deadline by size, so there is no class to pick and one offered anyway is refused.

steps.comment: A size class this pack does not grade by is refused rather than swallowed — an empty catalogue is still a catalogue.

projections.comment: `false`, not `null`: the question is answered, the answer is that nothing is owed.
projections.name: unappropriatedResult
